rationale: Raw source supports the income-yield and distribution anchors rather than a source-data defect: financial highlights report net investment income to average net assets of 9.75% for the six months ended June 30, 2025, and distributions from net investment income of $1.28 per share. The distribution rate is about 10% annualized and remains below 1.5 times the reported income-yield anchor (14.625%), so the F16 fire is a false alarm from the heuristic/check path rather than a filing extraction error.
